title: Durion Positivity Frontend Site Map
description: Machine-readable index of the frontend's navigable sections and their reachable pages, published as the read-only /sitemap.json build artifact and consumed by pos-mcp-server. Versioned; bump `version` on breaking shape changes. SECURITY: the artifact is served unauthenticated and is REDACTED — role-gated sections and pages are omitted and no `roles` fields are emitted, so every listed route is reachable by any authenticated user. The `roles` and `group:"admin"` shapes below remain valid but are not present in the published artifact.

version.description: Contract version of the site-map shape. Current: 2 (adds sections[].pages[]).

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this artifact was generated (per build).

titleKey.description: i18n key for the section title (SHELL.NAV.*). Absent for auto-discovered `other`-group sections.

title.description: Section title resolved to the base locale (en-US), or derived for `other`-group sections.

descriptionKey.description: i18n key for the section description (SITEMAP.SECTIONS.*). Absent for `other`-group sections.

description.description: Section description resolved to the base locale (en-US). Absent for `other`-group sections.

roles.description: Roles required to access the section; absent = all authenticated users.

group.description: Grouping of the section. Ordered main, then admin, then other (auto-discovered top-level segments with no curated metadata); sections[] is serialized by (group, order).

order.description: Sort order within the section's group (lower sorts earlier).

pages.description: Every reachable route under this section (excluding the section route itself), auto-extracted from the Angular route tree. Static pages sort before dynamic ones.

route.description: Full route path. Dynamic routes include `:param` segments, e.g. /app/crm/party/:partyId.

label.description: Label derived from the route's last static segment (title-cased). Not localized.

dynamic.description: True when the route contains `:param` segments and cannot be linked without an entity id.

params.description: Names of the `:param` segments, present only when dynamic.

roles.description: Roles required to reach this page; absent = inherits the section's access.
